summary: At the DTI doors, Carrie tells Bjorn and Gunnar there is no way back. Bjorn insists there is always a way; Carrie answers that this time there is not.
settingText: Exterior of the ordinary Department of Temporal Integration office at dusk. Heavy glass entrance doors sit at the top of broad brushed-concrete steps descending to a New York City street. Faint city glow and sodium streetlight gather beyond the steps; buses and commuters remain ordinary background shapes. Institutional glass and concrete, not a fortress or fantasy architecture.

panelPlan.action: One continuous full-page vertical image, no inset panels. Carrie stands rigidly near the closed glass doors. Bjorn is at the top edge of the concrete steps, facing the street with his back to her; at the last line he turns his head back toward Carrie, jaw set. Gunnar sits unmoving one step below Bjorn, looking toward the distant horizon. Keep all three figures legible within an intimate, medium-wide composition. The steps lead clearly down toward the street.

dialogueInline.speaker: Carrie
dialogueInline.text: There’s no way back from here.

dialogueInline.speaker: Bjorn
dialogueInline.text: There is always a way back.

summary: Carrie leads Bjorn and Gunnar down the DTI steps toward the street and their temporary lodging.
settingText: The same ordinary Department of Temporal Integration entrance and broad brushed-concrete steps at dusk, continuing directly from the preceding splash. Closed glass doors and the top landing recede behind the trio. The stairs descend to a New York City sidewalk with subdued bus lights, sodium streetlight, and a few commuters. Keep the municipal building plain and credible.

panelPlan.action: One continuous full-page vertical image, no inset panels. Carrie has turned from the DTI doors and leads the way down the steps, glancing back and gesturing for the men to follow. Bjorn and Gunnar descend behind her, still wary and disoriented. Frame the simple stair run from a low street-side angle so the trio’s movement toward the sidewalk is clear and the closed doors remain visible above them. The city street opens at the bottom of the composition.

dialogueInline.speaker: Carrie
dialogueInline.text: Come on, I’ll show you where you will be staying.
